_source: Lucid Trading — LucidFlex evaluation, 25K. Rules read 2026-10-29; confirm on your dashboard after any firm update.

drawdown.basis: end-of-day balance high-water mark — intraday excursions do not count

consistency.applies_to: evaluation only; the rule is dropped once funded
consistency.formula: largest single day profit / account profit must be at or below the limit

desk.book: one ES daily rule, one micro: buy a stop at the prior day's low when the session opens above the prior close, long only, 1.0 ATR stop, take 0.5R
desk.why: Chosen by mine26k.py: 287,280 configurations across ES, NQ, GC, CL and NKD, through four gates (positive in 2009-2019 and in 2020-2024, a parameter plateau, 2025-2026 not negative, and 500 random fills on the same days/side/stop/exit), then scored on this account from every starting trade in the 2023+ era, because a stop's dollar size is a property of the price level and older history was traded at a fifth of today's prices. The winner is ES, long only: buy a stop at the prior day's low, but only when the session opens above the prior close, stop 1.0 ATR, target 0.5R. 820 trades since 2009, 77.7% win, $49/trade, every year positive; 2023 onward 204 trades, 80.4% win, $95/trade, worst drawdown $1,086. As a 25K walked from all 204 recent starting points: 91% pass, 84% with the 40% consistency rule intact, 3% breach, median 14 sessions to the target, $413 of risk in a median session. It replaces the fade-5 0.5A tp1 + nr_break-2 1.0A tp1 pair, which passed 88% with consistency but took a median 26 sessions at a 59% win rate.

plan.next: when the 25K account has banked its cushion, either buy a 50K or fund the same 25K to +$2,000 of cushion before adding risk
plan.why: 50K is the smallest LucidFlex account that holds the wider-stop books (2.0-2.5 ATR) and the NQ lines at two micros; on a 25K those stops are one trade away from a breach, so they win more often and pass less often.
